title: The Necessary Interior
author: Vesper Winterbourne
blurb: Silas Quintana, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
